text.tspan: Internet Envoy: mTLS + port / address policy
Aliases and proxy-independent DNS are answered by the worker; unknown DNS needs existing Internet egress.
Public TCP defaults to 443; other ports require client configuration and receiver permission.
Direct Unix sockets, loopback adapters and explicit app proxy settings remain usable.
Application HTTPS / SMTPS stays end to end inside Realm mTLS; no gateway permission is added.

g.text: Public TCP: CONNECT / External DNS: DoH
Hosts / authoritative alias keeps TLS hostname
